topic: Web Development Fundamentals and Internet Basics
learningObjectives: Explain how websites and web applications work.
Identify the roles of browsers, servers, DNS, HTTP, and databases.
Trace a basic request from a browser to a web server and back.

activities.title: Web Architecture Map
activities.instruction: Connect the main parts of the web.

content.concept: A web application connects clients, servers, APIs, databases, and networks to deliver functionality to users.

activities.title: Web Technology Match
activities.instruction: Match each technology to its role.

content.concept: HTML structures content, CSS controls presentation, JavaScript adds behavior, and servers handle application logic and data.
